_about: Partner offers. An offer shows on every active route that passes within its radius (metres), or on every route if allRoutes is true. A Ride with GPS stop whose name matches matchPoi is replaced by the offer. Set validUntil (YYYY-MM-DD) to have it hide itself after that date. logo is a file in site/ (shown on the card in place of the partner name). conditions can be one line or a list of lines.
